q: His voice was like the sound of many waters; and the earth was illuminated with his glory.

q: This gate shall be shut. It shall not be opened, no man shall enter in by it; for the LORD, the God of Israel, has entered in by it.

q: But the Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, who performed the duty of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me

q: They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

q: They shall have linen turbans on their heads, and shall have linen trousers on their waists. They shall not clothe themselves with anything that makes them sweat.

s: priestly garments and grooming regulations requires changing garments before the outer court (ministering garments laid in holy rooms)
q: they shall put off their garments in which they minister and lay them in the holy rooms. They shall put on other garments, that they not sanctify the people with their garments.

s: priestly garments and grooming regulations requires hair cut but not shaved or long
q: They shall not shave their heads, or allow their locks to grow long. They shall only cut off the hair of their heads.
